title: Five per handle, Tutte's number per planar piece
claim: Let G be a connected three-fold odd gadget with n triangles whose dual H, with the corner line L, is a 3-regular triple system that is not 2-colourable, and let A(H, L) be half the number of 2-colourings of H - L (the colourings with L's seen value fixed). (1) The knot's exactness factor is lambda(0) = (-1)^(n-1) A(H, L), nonzero. (2) Point lemma: for a point p with three incidences (on lines l1, l2, l3, not necessarily distinct) of a signed system that is not colourable, the colourings of the other points in which the i-th incidence sees the complement of p's value and the other two see p's value number A(H, l_i); with all three seeing p's value there are none. (3) Factorization: the Pfaffian signings of a matching covered bipartite multigraph form one switching class, and across a tight cut of a Pfaffian cubic system, with pieces signed so that both are Pfaffian, if the piece B is not colourable and has one amplitude a(B) > 0 at its contracted vertex, then A(H, L) = a(B) A(H', L) for every line L of the other piece H', which is again not colourable; so A(H, L) is the product of the braces' amplitudes, for every corner L, whenever every brace's amplitude is corner-independent. (4) Brace amplitudes, all corner-independent and with any Pfaffian signing: the Heawood graph 5 (a Fano plane minus a line or a point), the doubled square 1, the trisum of three cubes 6, and a planar brace the number of Tutte matchings of its dual trinity (lines other than the corner matched bijectively to faces not at the corner, via a pointer argument on Kasteleyn signs), which is Tutte's tree-trinity number (the arborescence number; Kalman's hypertree count; the number of spanning trees of M when the brace is the omnitruncation of a map M). (5) Hence lambda(0) = (-1)^(n-1) 5^(number of Fano atoms) times Tutte's number for each planar glue brace (times 6 per trisum of three cubes); with the genus formula of THREEFOLD-SURFACES-20261030-001A, |lambda(0)| = 5^genus when the glue is doubled squares.
failure_conditions: A gadget on which the law's corner relation gives lambda(0) different from (-1)^(n-1) A(H, L).
A point of a non-colourable system violating the point lemma, or a tight cut where the amplitude does not factor.
A brace of the stated types whose amplitude depends on the corner or differs from 5, 1, 6 or Tutte's number.
A space whose amplitude differs from the product of its braces' amplitudes.
foundation_claim_scope: The knot's exactness factor at its own angle on three-fold odd gadgets with distinct corner triangles, through the duality of SPACE-SELECTION-20261030-001C; amplitudes of three-fold spaces whose braces are Heawood graphs, doubled squares, planar braces and the trisum of three cubes. Tutte's tree-trinity theorem and its hypertree form (Kalman) are external inputs, not replayed; general trisums are not treated.

validation.status: checked: the law's corner relation on gadgets of eight spaces (7 to 43 triangles) against (-1)^(n-1) A; the point lemma at every point of five spaces and five signed cores (three with a point held twice by a line); brace amplitudes at every corner; Tutte matchings and arborescence numbers of planar braces; the factorization on eleven spaces up to 90 points; controls fire; no human or external review
validation.novelty: external inputs: Tutte 1948 (tree trinity), Kalman 2013 (hypertrees), the survey of Mathews 2017 (Tutte matchings), Lovasz-Plummer (bipartite ear decompositions), Kasteleyn; nearest: Berman 1980 (|det| of the trinity adjacency matrix = number of Tutte matchings); the identification of the knot's amplitude with Tutte's tree-trinity number, the point lemma, the factorization over tight cuts and the amplitudes 5, 1, 6: no overlap found in one search (candidate local delta; folklore risk moderate for the elementary pointer argument)
validation.independence: Written by Claude in one session at the repository owner's request on 2026-10-30.
